framework: review-specific mixed-method risk-of-bias and applicability appraisal

dimensions.name: internal validity
dimensions.rationale: Random allocation supports comparison with open-text responses.

dimensions.name: measurement validity
dimensions.rationale: Self-reported clarity and richness proxies do not independently establish truth or interpretive depth.

dimensions.name: external validity
dimensions.rationale: A quota-balanced Prolific sample covers U.S. adults but only one reflective topic and online setting.

applicability: Direct for short online reflective interviews compared with open-text survey questions.
